overshoot.$description: Bedrock.engineer's overshooting swing: the theme switch indicator, and other small parts that snap into place.

standard.$description: A strong ease-out for plain changes that should not draw attention: hover and focus colors, press feedback.

fast.$description: Color changes on hover and focus (links, buttons, brand logos, the switch's triangles) and press feedback, with ease-standard.

swing.$description: Swings with ease-overshoot: the theme switch indicator's 60° rotation.
